extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: the largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation with over 100 K paired videos across 100 semantic conditions.
extraction.creator: Intelligent Creation Lab, ByteDance; The Chinese University of Hong Kong
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were collected from the Internet and then processed through commercial Image-to-Video models and community LoRAs to create paired videos.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: High-quality reference images from the Internet spanning various subjects.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential misuses include identity impersonation, deepfake content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may inherit stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations from the source commercial models and LoRAs.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models, meaning it inherits their limitations, such as poor generation of hands.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Research, education, and creative prototyping. Not intended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments.

name.evidence: We introduce VAP-Data , the largest to date, with over 100 K curated samples across 100 semantic conditions

description.evidence: we built VAP-Data, the largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation with over 100 K paired videos across 100 semantic conditions.

license.evidence: We will accompany any artifact release with a research-only license and an acceptable-use policy (AUP) that explicitly prohibits abusive or unlawful scenarios.

creator.evidence: 1Intelligent Creation Lab, ByteDance,2The Chinese University of Hong Kong

rai:dataCollection.evidence: We collect 2 K high-quality reference images from the Internet... We then use Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU [ 68] and Kling [ 40]) and community LoRAs [ 11] to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: We collect 2 K high-quality reference images from the Internet... We then use Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU [ 68] and Kling [ 40]) and community LoRAs [ 11] to create paired videos

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: We collect 2 K high-quality reference images from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases.

rai:dataSocialImpact.evidence: Potential misuses include identity impersonation, “deepfake” content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media.

rai:dataBiases.evidence: Thus, the dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models, leading to VAP may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: the dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models, leading to VAP may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., if the source models are poor at generating hands, VAP will likely not learn to generate hands well from this data).

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: VAP targets semantic-controlled video generation for research, education, and creative prototyping... It is not intended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments.
